status: PASS: PRIMARY RESULTS REPRODUCED; EXPLORATORY SCENARIOS COMPUTED
purpose: Assess numerical sensitivity to already identified source-definition/melting discrepancies, not choose favorable P values, determine valid exclusions or replace formal results.
classification: POST HOC EXPLORATORY; exclusions are hypothetical and unvalidated.

methods.experimental_unit: Author-confirmed independent animal, using existing paired target/reference Cq; no pairing inferred solely from well order.
methods.inference: Two-sided independent-group Welch t tests on delta Cq. Each scenario recalculates all 18 tests and adjusts them together with Holm.
methods.descriptive_expression: Q=2^(-delta Cq), with assumed efficiency E=2; Q divided by scenario-specific retained sham arithmetic mean Q for that gene.
methods.no_new_quality_control_validation: Neither apparent numerical robustness nor sensitivity legitimizes retrospective exclusion or establishes assay specificity. Standard curves/NTC/no-RT and explanations for plate discrepancies remain required or unavailable.
methods.restoration_time: Restoration is week8, four weeks after week4 removal; comparisons remain confounded by unmatched sampling time/second surgery.
methods.all_primary_records_preserved: No formal CSV/JSON, manuscript, source workbook, figures or primary result were changed.

baseline_reproduction.verification: PASS: all input pairs, S2 rows, summaries and 18-test outputs match S4.
limitations: The 100% equal-efficiency assumption requires experimental confirmation; a shared efficiency does not substitute for measured amplification-efficiency and assay-specificity validation.

Amplification/melting curves, no-template/no-RT controls, and assay detection/quantification limits are unavailable in supplied files. High Ct values for NOX4/AT1-R warrant review of raw curves and assay qualification; no values excluded.
β-actin is the only reference gene. Lack of a significant between-group β-actin Ct difference would not establish reference-gene stability or justify unverified normalization assumptions.
PCR report does not list RhoA/ROCK1/ROCK2 primers although the XLS contains those results. Their assay identities remain to be documented.
SCG group lacks original Ct data and is excluded from reanalysis.
The user supplied the biological-repeat and matching confirmation; original XLS does not itself contain specimen identifiers. Source columns are retained for traceability.
Each animal has one recorded qPCR measurement; technical repeat precision cannot be assessed from this workbook.
The 95% effect intervals are nominal, not simultaneous family-wise intervals; statistical significance is judged by the 18-test Holm-adjusted P values.
Results are an exploratory retrospective reanalysis of supplied data; they do not establish causal activation/inhibition of a pathway or mediation by the sympathetic nervous system.
